notes.title: Sassy Girl 0.5.4 released!
notes.content:
- 325 New images
- 5000 words
- 6 Animations 
- 2 New Achievement
In this important update, the MC will finally confront the truth with Miriam once and for all. Past choices will have the chance to unlock the first of the 5 endings of the story. MC, Beatrice, and poor Timmy will meet with Robert Ness. After the meeting, Beatrice will want to party.

notes.title: Sassy Girl 0.4.20
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282124/e5d586e2b8b8f9af914ef352793d89e3a620f882.jpg[/img]

With this release we come to the final chapter of Sassy Girl.
MC, after going through some strange experiences and learning incredible truths, begins to doubt his sanity.
In this update you will meet again Carla the psychotherapist and the beautiful Dorothy.
Be careful with your choices, as they may lead you to an ending you do not want.

- 500 new images
- 7 new scenes
- 20000 words 
- 20 animations
- 3 new achievements
